thesis.title: Thesis Simulation
thesis.subtitle: Multi-reader warehouse. Inventory runs will load this saved scene later.
thesis.emptyCanvas: Create a section in the sidebar, then place devices and stations. Turn selected stations into readers.

sizeFields.locked: This section is initialized — size is frozen.

runsPanel.title: Runs ({{count}})
runsPanel.empty: No inventory runs yet. Click "New run" to start one.
runsPanel.hint: Each run freezes the current scene and records a full event log you can replay by clicking any device.
runsPanel.workingHint: The simulation engine is generating the full event log. This can take a few seconds for large scenes.

newRun.title: New inventory run
newRun.hint: Pick a paging scheme and parameters. The run uses the currently initialized scene.

timeline.noEvents: No events for this device in the selected run.
timeline.unsupported: Timeline is available for devices only in this phase.

readerFormulas.title: Effective reader coverage (3GPP TR 38.769)
readerFormulas.note: EH is modeled as a harvest-rate (device charge over time), not a hard distance cutoff. Toggling off "include D2R" falls back to R2D-only.

readerList.title: Readers ({{count}})
readerList.empty: No readers yet. Convert selected stations into readers from the sidebar.
readerList.hint: Click a reader to highlight the devices it can inventory. Click again to clear.

thesis.populationWarnLarge: Beyond {{count}} placements renders slowly; the server caps at 20000.
thesis.bulkHint: This section is initializing. Add devices and stations, turn some stations into readers, then Save to mark it initialized.
thesis.bulkLocked: This section is initialized. Edit or place one node at a time. Bulk generate stays off.
thesis.clearDevicesConfirm: Remove every device from this section? This cannot be undone.
thesis.clearInfraConfirm: Remove every station and reader from this section? This cannot be undone.
thesis.discardConfirm: This section is not saved. Discard it?
thesis.deleteSectionBody: Delete "{{name}}" and everything placed in it? This cannot be undone.

params.include_d2r: Include D2R uplink leg (uncheck = R2D only, legacy)

errors.bad_param: Check the numbers in this card.

errors.bad_count: Enter a whole number of nodes.

errors.grid_empty: That spacing does not fit a station in this warehouse.
